# M18-S7 unit D (F13): region_escape stops a loGo/s package before
# escape analysis, so one lint run over a workspace with one loGo/s
# module and one Go module still reports the escape of the first and the
# arena fallback of the second. The Go module holds no regions for the
# escape rule, but its global store kills the region record, which
# escape analysis reports as perf::arena_fallback.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"rule_id":"correctness::region_escape"'
stderr '"rule_id":"perf::arena_fallback"'

-- go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./a
	./b
)

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/arenalint-a

go 1.27

-- a/a.lgo --
package a

import "logos/arena"

type box struct {
	r arena.Region
}

func Store(b *box) {
	r := arena.Open()
	b.r = r
}

-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/arenalint-b

go 1.27

-- b/b.go --
package b

import "logos/arena"

var global *int

func Store() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	global = p
	_ = global
}
